original.title: NASA Scientists Show How Gravitational Waves Can Reveal New Worlds
original.summary: The LISA (Laser Interferometer Space Antenna) observatory, now in development, will detect gravitational waves, the tiny ripples in space-time caused by orbiting masses. Now two studies led by NASA astrophysicists show in new detail how LISA could reveal a new and unique population of exoplanets — worlds beyond our solar system — throughout our galaxy. […]
original.podcastScript:
Hello, this is Earth Signal.

Today's story comes from NASA News: NASA Scientists Show How Gravitational Waves Can Reveal New Worlds.

The report says: The LISA (Laser Interferometer Space Antenna) observatory, now in development, will detect gravitational waves, the tiny ripples in space-time caused by orbiting masses. Now two studies led by NASA astrophysicists show in new detail how LISA could reveal a new and unique population of exoplanets — worlds beyond our solar system — throughout our galaxy. […]

The signal is the longer trend behind the headline: how technology keeps moving into public life, infrastructure, science and everyday decisions.
original.aiInsight: The important signal is not just the event, but the system it points to: technology is becoming part of how societies manage risk, opportunity and trust.

zh.title: 太空与卫星技术释放新的地球观测信号
zh.summary: 这条新闻关注太空与卫星技术的新进展，它可能帮助人类更好理解地球、气候、灾害或未来探索。
zh.podcastScript:
今天的 Earth Signal 来自全球科技新闻现场。

我们关注的是：太空与卫星技术释放新的地球观测信号。这条新闻关注太空与卫星技术的新进展，它可能帮助人类更好理解地球、气候、灾害或未来探索。

如果把它放在更长的时间线上看，这不只是一次技术更新。它说明科技正在更深地进入城市、公共服务、环境风险和普通人的日常选择。

值得听的地方在于：真正改变生活的，往往不是某个单点发明，而是它和社会系统连接起来之后，开始重新分配效率、风险和机会。

今天的信号是：技术越靠近地球，越需要被听见的不只是速度，还有它会把我们带向怎样的生活。
zh.aiInsight: 这条新闻真正指向的，是人类正在用更高维度的技术重新理解地球。当太空、气候和城市治理连在一起，科技就不只是远方的探索，也会变成每个人生活里的安全感。
